description: Account Engagement Tracking and Consent loader on pi.pardot.com/pdt.js and pi.demand.salesforce.com/pdt.js. Salesforce documents aid on the query. Legacy pd.js puts piAId in JavaScript and is not contracted.

params.name: aid
params.description: It is the Account Engagement account ID (piAId). Salesforce documents the loader as pdt.js?aid= plus that value.
params.fix_hint: Copy the Tracking and Consent snippet so aid carries the account ID.
